correctness.rationale: The source Theorem 3.1 supplies the fixed-tau O(sqrt(epsilon)) weak-edge reduction. Its zero eigenvector has components sqrt(M_i)/sqrt(sum M_i), so a unit supremum forces M1=M3 by zero-mode projection and positivity. Contraction plus diagonal spectral-measure equality then forces L11=L33 and k1=k2. In that symmetric case the 0, k/M, k/M+2k/m eigenspaces yield C31=M/(2M+m)-(1/2)cos(omega_a tau)+m/(2(2M+m))cos(omega_s tau). Equality requires phases (pi,0) only; Kronecker density gives Q=1 nonattained for irrational rho; a closed rational torus orbit reaches phases iff numerator even/denominator odd. Pell x^2-3q^2=1 with x even q odd gives the explicit <pi^2/(72q^2) deficit. Independently diagonalized examples, asymmetric bounds and Pell arithmetic passed; they do not establish uniform-in-time fixed-epsilon statements.
